review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one theorem, `solution`, and it declares no simp lemmas, no `@[simp]` attributes and no simp sets. The only simp call is `by simp` at line 112. It proves `IsLocalRing.closedPoint _ ∈ Set.range ⇑(T.fromSpecResidueField p)`. That is a small, routine side goal, and I saw nothing suggesting the simp set is wrong for it. The long `attribute [-simp]` and `attribute [-instance]` lines at the top look like generated boilerplate. They switch off many simp lemmas imported from other files, including auto-generated `mk.injEq` and `sizeOf_spec` lemmas. I found no evidence in this file that any particular disabled rule loops, competes with another rule, or expands a term in an unwanted way. Judging whether those upstream lemmas have the right orientation would need the other files, and this proof does not depend on them. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out problems that would only show up in the simplifier. The remaining uncertainty is that the real reason for each `-simp` removal is not documented here.
